versions.changelog: Reworked commuter-to-workplace matching to reproduce census commute totals exactly and even out block-to-block variation; recomputed map geometry in the map's local projection for a lighter download and wider default view.

Refreshed maps onto the full modeling pipeline (foundations, bathymetry, 3D heights, land use, military demand); restored dropped coastal and island neighborhoods and corrected on-base resident counts.
Added military-base demand and expanded special-demand and point seeding for the Ōsaka and Fukuoka maps.
Added ocean bathymetry, neighborhood labels, and Overture buildings, and made driving-time estimates less optimistic.
Added university, zoo, aquarium, and botanical-garden demand; rebalanced population and improved point placement.
Added port and hospital demand, rebalanced special demand, and corrected school-age commute demand.
Initial release of the Kitakyūshū map with census-based residents and workers, commute demand, school demand, and neighborhood labels.
